guide.rematter.page.21:
Water later

Connect Electrolyzer and Reactor to a Drive with a Cell. Supply FE.

Import a water bucket through Decomposer; keep its input empty.

Choose Water electrolysis, Use recipe, then Start.
guide.rematter.page.1:
ReMatter Guide

Start with a Hand Preparator and furnace. Make a Cell, then connect Decomposer, Drive and Synthesizer to turn sand into glass.

The Cell stays in the Drive. No Analyzer, AE2 or RS is required.
guide.rematter.page.2:
Hand Preparator

Top: Flint, Iron, Flint.
Middle: Copper, Iron, Copper.
Bottom: 3 Iron Ingots.

Insert feedstock and press Crank until the batch finishes.
guide.rematter.page.3:
Extract two fractions

Left input: 1 Sand. Leave the other two empty. Crank for 1 Silith.

Collect it; repeat with 1 Clay Ball for 1 Argil.

These are useful mineral fractions, not pure elements.
guide.rematter.page.4:
Mix and heat

Left: 1 Silith.
Middle: 1 Argil.
Right: empty.

Crank for 4 Matrix Blend. No water needed.

Smelt each Blend in a furnace for 1 Matrix Crystal.
guide.rematter.page.5:
Craft parts

Frame: Structural Bars in the corners, Iron Ingots along the edges and Matrix Blend in the centre.

Circuit: Copper Ingots in the corners, Redstone above and below Matrix Blend, and Argil to its left and right.
guide.rematter.page.6:
64k Matter Cell

Housing: Structural Bars in the corners and Glass along the edges.

Stack top to bottom:
Control Circuit
Matrix Crystal
Cell Housing

Its reusable Crystal is not fuel.
guide.rematter.page.7:
First network

Drive: Machine Frames in the corners, Cell Racks to either side of a Control Circuit, Structural Bars above and a Mint Matrix Crystal below.

Place Decomposer and Synthesizer beside the Drive. Insert a Cell in any bay and supply FE to both processors.
guide.rematter.page.8:
Sand into storage

Open Decomposer. Insert Sand in its input and press Start.

Its cutter separates stored Silica into the connected Drive.

The Cell stays in storage. Processors do not accept new Cells.
guide.rematter.page.9:
Side tabs

Process: inputs and progress.
Contents: storage.
Upgrades: speed or efficiency.
Configuration: automation and settings.

Hover symbols and bars for help.
guide.rematter.page.10:
Make glass

Open Recipe, search Glass and select it. Use recipe, then Start.

Collect the Glass from the Synthesizer.

Default: 1 Sand to 1 Glass, 24,000 FE total. The Cell remains in the connected Drive.
guide.rematter.page.11:
Control work

Start: one recipe batch. Pause and Resume keep the order.

Configuration: enable Automation and Run nonstop.

Use hoppers to feed Decomposer and empty Synthesizer.
guide.rematter.page.12:
Why a crystal?

Heating bonds the mineral blend into a porous crystal matrix. Selective storage in that matrix is fiction, inspired by real material separation.

A Cell holds stock. Recipes describe products; they add no matter.
guide.rematter.page.13:
Powered preparation

Material Preparator uses FE. Inputs run left to right; unused slots stay empty.

Grind Iron, Copper or Gold Ingots into Dust, 1:1, for 4,000 FE each.

No Cell needed.
guide.rematter.page.14:
Five useful fractions

Sand gives Silith.
Clay Ball gives Argil.

Powered preparation also gives:
Redstone: Rhedon.
Quartz: Virel.
Glowstone: Lumin.

Each extraction costs 2,000 FE. Silith + Argil makes Matrix Blend.
guide.rematter.page.15:
Alloy powders

Powered inputs, left to right:
Rhevon: 3 Iron Dust, 1 Copper Dust, 1 Rhedon.
Lumivex: 3 Copper Dust, 1 Gold Dust, 1 Lumin.

Each batch makes 4 Powder for 8,000 FE. Heat next.
guide.rematter.page.16:
Industrial Preparator

Shell: 3–9 wide and deep, 5–9 high. Use at least a 3×4 or 4×3 footprint and 2 Ports.

Cutter + Filter + Basin. Each mounts on floor or ceiling. Click a support's top or bottom face.

More Cutters/Basins: speed. More Filters: less FE.
guide.rematter.page.17:
Larger Cells

Each Cell stores up to 512 types. Capacities are 64k, 256k and 1M units.

256k uses a Matrix Cluster and two Ender Conductors. 1M uses four Clusters, an Optical Circuit, Diamond Lattice, an Ender Conductor and a Netherite Sheath.
guide.rematter.page.18:
Virelite Ceramic

Mix with FE: 1 Silith + 1 Argil + 1 Virel = 4 Virelite Powder.

Sinter Furnace: 1 Powder to 1 Ceramic for 12,000 FE.

Rhevon and Lumivex Powder sinter into Ingots at the same cost.
guide.rematter.page.19:
Heat and recycle

Alloy Powder smelts or blasts to Ingots, 1:1.

Preparator, Mekanism Crusher and Oritech Pulverizer grind Ingots back to the same Powder.

Oritech Foundry: 2 Powders to 2 Ingots.
guide.rematter.page.20:
Analyzer and limits

Insert a sample and supply FE. The Analyzer shows composition and keeps the item. No Cell needed.

Analysis is not an unlock. Synthesis permits approved materials, not machines or components.

guide.rematter.page.22:
AE2 and RS

Use one Network Interface per system. In Configuration, choose its backend and turn Automation on.

Enable Network jobs on processors. Both systems can request supported recipes from shared stock.
guide.rematter.page.23:
Industrial Reactor

Shell: 3-9 wide/deep, 4-9 high; 2+ Ports.

Stabilizer + Focus. Both mount on floor or ceiling and turn automatically.

More Foci: speed. More Stabilizers: less FE. Connect outward Ports.
guide.rematter.page.24:
Expand the network

Each Drive holds six removable Cells. Start with one.

Limit: 64 Drives and 256 total nodes. Use loaded connections under the same owner.

Upgrades: four of one type. Speed +25% FE each. Efficiency -5% FE each.
guide.rematter.page.25:
When work waits

Check available matter, inputs, FE and output room. Matter Cables link the network and forward FE from a connected source.

Keep unreadable Cells safe.
